OUR CHURCH 12 CORE VALUES:

1. I AM A TRUE DISCIPLE

John 8:31 (AMP) 
So Jesus was saying to the Jews who had believed Him, “If you abide in My word [continually obeying My teachings and living in accordance with them, then] you are truly My disciples.

SIGNS OF A TRUE DISCIPLE

John 13:34 (AMP)
I am giving you a new commandment, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, so you too are to love one another.

SIGNS OF A TRUE DISCIPLE
My Father is glorified and honoured by this, when you bear much fruit, and prove yourselves to be My [true] disciples.
Understand, Live and Transmit the vision
TO LOVE GOD AND TO LOVE PEOPLE.

37 Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’ 38 This is the first and great commandment. 39 And the second is like it: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
TO WIN SOULS AND MAKE DISCIPLES THAT WILL MAKE DISCIPLES.

19 Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations, baptising them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, 20 teaching them to observe all things that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.
TO BECOME A STRATEGIC DISCIPLE MAKING CHURCH (4XD:ACTSDNA)
If people can’t see what God is doing, they stumble all over themselves; But when they attend to what he reveals, they are most blessed.

Be caught by the vision of God. Sometimes we don’t conquer because we don’t have a clear vision from God. We don’t see that there is a purpose behind all the things we do. On the other hand, sometimes we just settle on the culture we used to see. Christianity is more than the church activities and traditions. The world can only be conquered by sharing the gospel and through discipleship.

3. COMMITTED TO CELL LIFE.

Care groups are small groups of people who meet weekly to develop all around growth that’s centred on the word of God. They are small centres for studying the bible in a simple and practical way; people learn how to apply the word to their daily lives. It’s a time to encourage, care, pray and support one another. It’s the place where friendships are formed, and lives are celebrated.

Leadership is not about what you can accomplish.  It’s about equipping others to do the same.  Ministry cannot end with you. We must multiply ourselves so that others are equipped and empowered to serve the Lord and be involved with this vision of winning souls and making disciples.

We need to understand that cell group ministry is about multiplying the number of empowered and equipped leaders, leaders that are consumed with the vision of winning souls and making disciples for the Lord. Jesus ministry here on earth provides us with a simple and clear multiplication principles for producing leaders. As a caregroup leader you need to release your team to repeat the process over and over again.

4. PASSIONATE SPIRITUALITY DEVOTIONAL LIFE.

There is no greater disaster in the spiritual life than that of a restless and undernourished soul. Pursuing the trappings of success and forgetting the triumph of significance.

WE MUST PRACTICE THE FOLLOWING DISCIPLINES:
Surrender is giving in to God so we can hear and embrace Him. Surrender is an act of prayer and prayer is an act of surrender. We need to surrender everything to God as we pray unto Him.

This Book of the Law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate on it day and night, so that you may be careful to do according to all that is written in it. For then you will make your way prosperous, and then you will have good success.

Before the promise is the premise. When the mind is enriched, the heart is enlightened and the soul prospers. We need to experience the prosperity of our souls first and other things will fall into its right places.
Your word I have treasured and stored in my heart, That I may not sin against You.

The shallowness of our generation is particularly seen in our shallowness in the word of God. No deep roots. No deep foundations. Engaging daily in the word of God is a painstaking discipline for which many are not willing to pay the price.The word of God is not merely good thoughts to appreciate but it is a necessary truth to apply.

WE MUST PRACTICE THE FOLLOWING DISCIPLINES:
Now in the morning, having risen a long while before daylight, He went out and departed to a solitary place; and there He prayed.

Jesus regular habit was to spend time alone with God the Father. It was important as He declared His dependence upon God and lived His earthly life to glorify Him! 
All believers can multiply their effectiveness in prayer by utilising the discipline of fasting. God's work is intensified and magnified when we pray and fast! Prayer with fasting is one of the most powerful but perhaps one of the least used spiritual success tools in the life of many people. Prayer and fasting helps us walk more closely with God and we begin to see that even stressful times may actually produce positive results thereby living a life of holiness.

5. SUBMISSION TO AUTHORITY
Love, honour and Respect my leaders.

1 Let every soul be subject to the governing authorities. For there is no authority except from God, and the authorities that exist are appointed by God. 2 Therefore whoever resists the authority resists the ordinance of God, and those who resist will bring judgment on themselves.

“Many times God will send us what we need in a package we don’t want. This very presentation will manifest the true condition of our heart, exposing whether we are submitted to His authority or resistant to it.”

“Those who honour authority, walk in great authority, and respect follows them. They have attracted the blessing of God. Those who revile authority, or lightly esteem authority, sow a harvest of disrespect and cause judgment to follow them.”

Honour means to esteem, elevate, and hold someone in high regard and high value. When we honour the leaders that God has placed in our lives, we walk in true humility. When we humble ourselves, God gives us the grace needed to fulfill our callings. For us to effectively serve our leaders, God wants to refine and mold us into who we were created to be. The humble are those who God promotes. Unfortunately, most Christians do not understand what honour truly is or how important it is in The Kingdom of God. In today’s culture, we are seeing a tremendous lack of honour, particularly towards those in all manners of secular authority. Likewise, the sad truth is we also are seeing dishonour toward church leadership. As Christians, we are instructed to honour our church leaders, valuing them with honour.
Dear brothers and sisters, honour those who are your leaders in the Lord’s work. They work hard among you and give you spiritual guidance.

The local church is a kingdom, a kingdom that is an authority with order and structure. Yet, some people treat church like a social club or think of it as a Sunday hangout spot. Satan wants Christianity to become a culture that devalues the local church and its leaders. His goal is to ultimately tear down the Kingdom of God. In these last days, ministry is becoming more difficult for leaders. 

Here are some startling statistics on ministry leaders: These statistics provide insight into the culture of the body of Christ and explain why many churches are closing their doors and ministry leaders are throwing in the towel. 
57% can't pay their bills
24% have a difficult time recruiting volunteers
One of the biggest burdens God has placed on me is to see the local church strengthened, and for that to happen, its leaders must be strengthened

You and I can make a significant impact on our cities and churches by serving the leaders God has placed in our lives with honour. Just as Aaron and Hur held up Moses’ arms during battle when he was exhausted, we must hold up our leader’s arms. We must lighten the load, come alongside them, and help carry their burden. When the church honours its leaders and serves the vision of the pastor, there will be unity. When that blessing is on a church or ministry team, the members of that church become unstoppable in their communities. 
Honour is the key to multiplication - that exponential increase of effectiveness in ministry and in the blessings of God within our lives. 

The whole infrastructure of the Kingdom of God is built upon honour.
Manage and invest my time for the Kingdom of God.

Show me where you spend your money and I can tell something about you. But show me where you spend your time and I will know the real you. What you do with God's time is your gift back to him...Time is a gift from God and we must learn to value the time we have been given.

Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow we will go to such and such a city, spend a year there, buy and sell, and make a profit”; whereas you do not know what will happen tomorrow. For what is your life? It is even a vapour that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

It’s not enough to have a purpose and to know the purpose…WE MUST FULFIL IT! Not any other day, but today!

Life is like a vapour! It is like a morning mist that soon vanishes. Life is short and uncertain. There are no guarantees about tomorrow.

“Tomorrow is the excuse of the lazy and the refuge of the incompetent”
Procrastination is the mother of all aborted dreams. Procrastination never won a race, received a promotion or changed the outcome of a situation.IT IS A TIME-BOMB SET TO EXPLODE!
Teach us to realise the brevity of life, so that we may grow in wisdom.

Every waking moments of our lives is a gift that only God can give and the way we use each shining hour is our way of giving thanks to God!

7. LIFELONG RELATIONSHIP

18 Jesus came up and said to them, “All authority (all power of absolute rule) in heaven and on earth has been given to Me. 19 Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations [help the people to learn of Me, believe in Me, and obey My words], baptising them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit, 20 teaching them to observe everything that I have commanded you; and lo, I am with you always [remaining with you perpetually—regardless of circumstance, and on every occasion], even to the end of the age.”
The great commandment and the great commission means advancing the kingdom of God, so as to expand the same here on earth as it is in heaven.
Jesus came up and said to them, “ALL AUTHORITY (all power of absolute rule) in heaven and on earth has been given to Me.

The source of the great commission was the all authority that has been given to Jesus. It was not just addressed to the apostles. Many christians hold on to the notion that discipleship is only for the spiritual elite, the spiritual commandos and it is not meant for the whole church. It is only for reverend, bishops, pastors and leaders.The rest are contented to be non-disciples, as if it is an option. Winning souls and making disciples are not just for few elite people it is for every child of God!
Then the word of God spread, and the NUMBER of the DISCIPLES MULTIPLIED greatly in Jerusalem, and a great many of the priests were OBEDIENT to the faith.

Discipleship:the intentional training of christians with accountability on the basis of relationship for the purpose of multiplication. Yes discipleship is costly but non-discipleship is even more costlier to the higher level. The solution to the problem: let us all become true disciples and let us disciple others. Let us all be united and obey Jesus’ great commission! Then the church will be healthy and then true revival will come!

8. I LOVE EQUIPPING AND TRAINING
We did not do anything wrong but somehow we lost.

3 things that we can learn from Nokia.
They missed out on continually:
Learning

As a disciple of the Lord we can learn from this powerful truths and apply it as well in our daily lives. If we will notice these 3 things don't happen by accident but instead we need to intentionally do something about it to make it happen. The advantage we have yesterday will be replaced by the trends of tomorrow.
And the things you have heard me say in the presence of many witnesses entrust to reliable people who will also be qualified to teach others.

Disciple making is all about a certain kind of person who is radically committed to a certain kind of purpose and who, through a certain kind of process, reproduces a certain kind of product. A certain kind of person. A certain kind of purpose. A certain kind of process it is an intentional process of testifying, teaching, training and transmitting our convictions and our life to those would pass it on to others.

9. I AM A LEADER OF 7 DISCIPLES
Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

A certain kind of product we reproduce after our kind. So the key is not merely to try to disciple someone to be the right product; it is for ourselves to be the right product. Apostle Paul was confident because he was certain that he is really replicating the pattern created by Christ. His DNA is the DNA of Christ that is why he was rest assured that he was setting a Godly example.

10. ACCOMPLISHING CHURCH GOAL
Setting support, help and fulfil the goals

1 When word came to Sanballat, Tobiah, Geshem the Arab and the rest of our enemies that I had rebuilt the wall and not a gap was left in it—though up to that time I had not set the doors in the gates— 2 Sanballat and Geshem sent me this message: “Come, let us meet together in one of the villages on the plain of Ono.” But they were scheming to harm me; 3 so I sent messengers to them with this reply: “I am carrying on a great project and cannot go down. Why should the work stop while I leave it and go down to you?”

Nehemiah was a picture of a man who had a vision, Nehemiah was a picture of a person who was focus, he was dedicated, he was following the instruction of the Lord to rebuild the wall. He was a follower. He was following God's promptings in his heart. When the wall was about to be completed now distraction, started to come in. But how did he replied, he said this words I am doing a great work, I cannot come down.

WE NEED TO BE FOCUSED IN ORDER TO FULFILL OUR CHURCH GOAL.
What is distraction? Distraction is anything that will cause you to be demoted. What do we mean to be demoted? Distraction is anything that will cause you to come down from where God has placed you to be.
Four times they sent me the same message, and each time I gave them the same answer.

21 So Elisha turned back from him, and took a yoke of oxen and slaughtered them and boiled their flesh, using the oxen’s equipment, and gave it to the people, and they ate. Then he arose and followed Elijah, and became his servant.

What is Elisha thinking? God often uses the most are the ones that hold on to the least.

To be where God wants us to be and to accomplish what God wants us to accomplish - we need focus and radical commitment.

11. I WANT TO SEE MY CHURCH GROW
Don't think what America can do for you but think what you can do for America.- John F. Kennedy
THE CHURCH IS THE HOPE OF THE WORLD.- BILL HAMMON

My heart is breaking as I remember how it used to be: I walked among the crowds of worshipers, leading a great procession to the house of God, singing for joy and giving thanks amid the sound of a great celebration!

We need to maintain our passionate love and commitment to the Lord and his church. The truth is when you don't invest you will not be interested. If we haven't given our lives and committed unto the Lord and His Church we will not really care about His Church.

King David made provisions for the house of God.

2 Using every resource at my command, I have gathered as much as I could for building the Temple of my God. Now there is enough gold, silver, bronze, iron, and wood, as well as great quantities of onyx, other precious stones, costly jewels, and all kinds of fine stone and marble. 3 “And now, because of my devotion to the Temple of my God, I am giving all of my own private treasures of gold and silver to help in the construction. This is in addition to the building materials I have already collected for his holy Temple.
King David prepared everything and give above and over for the house of God.

You hoped for rich harvests, but they were poor. And when you brought your harvest home, I blew it away. Why? Because my house lies in ruins, says the Lord of Heaven’s Armies, while all of you are busy building your own fine houses.

Let us build the house of God.Let us build the body of Christ.Let us show not only in words but in our deeds that we really love God and His Church.
Where there is a church in unity.Where there is a church in one accord. Where there is a church that stands united in faith. Many will be saved, and many miracles, signs and wonders will be performed in the name of Jesus Christ! Signs and wonders will follow the preaching of the Word of God!
Make every effort to keep yourselves united in the Spirit, binding yourselves together with peace.
I will prepare the next generation

We have a huge responsibility before us that should not be taken lightly. We are helping to raise up a future generation of young people that will hopefully impact their world for Jesus Christ. This is the reason why it is very important for both parents and children to make an effort to establish and maintain communication. As a family, it is very important spend time in the word on a regular basis.

18 “Therefore you shall lay up these words of mine in your heart and in your soul, and bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes. 19 You shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up. 20 And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates, 21 that your days and the days of your children may be multiplied in the land of which the Lord swore to your fathers to give them, like the days of the heavens above the earth.
All Scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness,

The blessing God has for the family has passed down from parents to their children from generation to generation. It is every parent's responsibility to teach the Word of God to their children. It is important that you consistently give the Word to your children until its teaching becomes a way of life for everyone in your home.

My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I also will reject you from being priest for Me; Because you have forgotten the law of your God, I also will forget your children.
“Parents, please listen to this truth.If you forget the Word of God, it is difficult for God to bless your children.”This hurts them by stunting their spiritual growth.”- Ptr. Cesar Castellanos

Do not neglect to give your children what they need to be successful—a steady diet of God's Word tempered with love.

WHAT ONE GENERATION NEGLECTS,THE NEXT GENERATION REJECTS.- Rev. Edmund Chan

Let us all be in unity to raise up children/young people that are 4XD acts DNA disciples. As spiritual and physical parents let us all lead our children/young people to grow as true disciples of the living God, by first living and continually levelling up as true disciples of Jesus Christ!
